reviews.title: Amazing app for mild to moderate alcoholics
reviews.text: I started sunnyside going on 6 months ago— I now pay for the membership & sunnyside med. the tracking helped me a lot, however, i was still drinking multiple times a week. I never knew about medication to help reduce cravings. It is DEFINITELY worth the $$ !!! if you have a drinking problem and want to stop or slow down. I didn’t think it would be at first but i got to a point when i knew i needed to at least give it a try. It’s worth it, I highly recommend to anybody struggling and wanting to quit drinking entirely or wanting to drastically cut back. This is the app for you.

reviews.title: Texts
reviews.text: Use your throwaway number when you sign up. They’ve harassed me every week for years. They won’t stop texting. Plus, it didn’t work. I went to AA and am now sober  2.5 years. Skip the app and quit wasting years. Cut straight to AA!

reviews.title: Very useful app
reviews.text: This App is easy to use.  Prompts keep you on track daily.  It is easy to set goals and keep track of your progress.  It’s been very helpful for me.

reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: The app is really cool. It wasn’t something I felt like I could use at the time but would recommend. I was charged the membership fee without being aware and when I reached out to Customer Service, they refunded me completely!

reviews.title: Downloader Beware!
reviews.text:
I wish I had read some of the reviews here beforehand. 

I deleted the app shortly after downloading because I couldn't afford a subscription. Thought that would be the end of it, but nope! For weeks after I was spammed with texts asking why I didn't complete my account, with one representative going as far as to sign me up for a "free trial" without my consent. Texting "STOP" to these messages didn't work, and even after going on their website to delete the account I am still recieving texts and emails advertising a medication I have absolutley zero interest in taking. Ridiculous. 

These pushy marketing tactics are not only annoying but also distinctly predatory. Do better.

reviews.title: Bad Business Model
reviews.text:
I had used this app a while back and they had a monthly subscription option—fairly priced and worth it to try out for a bit. Their new business model is not cool to only offer a $99 yearly subscription or a $299 premium yearly subscription…especially when I saw a reply on a previous review offering someone a monthly option if they email them directly. If that is someone you offer, it seems almost predatory to make the only options yearly subscriptions and after a trial goes to the MOST EXPENSIVE option. 😥 

Now they have a free trial that I, and I admit should have paid more attention, just found out after doing the trial turns automatically into a $299 yearly subscription. I didn’t cancel the trial in time but thought it was the monthly plan it used to be, then got a notice from my bank of a declined transaction of $299. I immediately cancelled the subscription and contacted the app developers right away. Because it was through the app store they cannot do anything about it. Now because I do not have $300 in my account and cannot afford to deposit that much to be taken out and wait for Apple to refund me…which after waiting for the transaction to get out of pending status and then issue a refund (which the Apple rep did offer me) could end up totaling 7+ business days (so potentially 9+ actual days)…I am essentially locked out of using my Apple account to download even free apps until I can afford to have that money come out of my account. 

People struggling with substance use are not all rich. While part of this is apple’s system in which they cannot reverse a pending charge…I can’t help but think how this is a largely inconsiderate business model. If you want to help people, I suggest allowing them to pay for your app by the month or even quarter in an upfront manner. And if you really cannot offer that, at least have it default after a trial to the $99 yearly option. Yall have to know people forget to unsubscribe to free trials…and after receiving 36 text messages from yall in a 8 day period, during which I had to opt out once…still kept getting messages, then opt out a second time for them to finally stop…a simple reminder text that your free trial is expiring and you will be charged $299 maybe would have been a nice feature. 

Unfortunately when you have to choose between paying $299 for an app or paying you legally required car insurance or rent to not be evicted, you have to choose those actual necessities. So I guess hopefully in 3-4 weeks when I can manage to have $299 held up for 7-9 days I can finally do things like download free apps on my phone…

It really bothers me that you offer people who are upset about your costs options to do a monthly subscription, but not the decency to offer it people who want to try your app and instead leave the option be to default to $299 yearly models. This has put me in a tough spot.

reviews.title: Cut back
reviews.text: I’ve been able to cut my drinking probably by 75% since using Sunnyside and naltrexone

reviews.title: Amazing resource
reviews.text: This is the only app that has actually helped me get results and stick to my plan to drink less. Thank you SS!

reviews.title: Nannyberry
reviews.text: When I first started, Sunnyside, I was averaging about 2 1/2 drinks a day on holidays. Now my every day drink total is between four and seven drinks per week. I get excited about the challenge of skipping drink days. And now when I report on Dry days, I get a huge degree of satisfaction. I no longer feel like I have to drink every day. But I do enjoy my glass of wine with dinner or a margarita in the evening. I recommend Sunnyside for people who really need to just “knock it off” but don’t want to  quit completely!!🙏

reviews.title: Impossible to unsubscribe
reviews.text: Do not join this program ! While it was useful for a few months a few years ago, it has been impossible to get rid of them. First I couldn’t cancel my paid membership until my renewal date so I paid for services I wasn’t using. And they continue to send spam texts selling medication I neither want nor need. No matter how I block and report them the sales spam continues to arrive. I can only conclude that this is a fraudulent grift and if you actually need help controlling your drinking you are better off going elsewhere for support.

reviews.title: Alcohol
reviews.text: I do not drink any alcohol and quit smoking in 1992.

reviews.title: Leave me alone!
reviews.text: I quit the account, deleted the app, begged them to lose my details and I still receive daily harassment from Sunnyside. Sure, you can quit alcohol, but apparently, there is no way to quit this app or their daily SMS.

reviews.title: In app tour is broken
reviews.text: Your in app tour is broken, I literally can’t use the app. It breaks and shuts down the app after the 4th step. Please fix!!!!

reviews.title: Effective but
reviews.text: I don’t care for the reminders that pop up on my AppleCar Play for everyone in the car to see I use an alcohol moderation app.  That’s my bizz.  Second, need a lite version for about 20 bucks per year that excludes the support people.  I just want to track my consumption to stay honest.  3) the prompts are rarely helpful, I’m like the thousands of members that disregard the prompt and and free lance whatever we want to get off our chest, like how hard it is to give up social lives and friends while reducing or quitting alcohol.

reviews.title: Sunnyside Is Super Helpful!
reviews.text: I love Sunnyside! I am on my third year of using the app. It has helped me feel more in control of my drinking and I still appreciate the daily reminders to help me stay on track with my goals!

reviews.title: Solid app but always breaks
reviews.text: I love the idea of this app but it’s so annoying how often it opens to a blank screen.

reviews.title: $299 a year is insane
reviews.text: After the free trial, everything in the app is fully disabled and all it does is give you a prompt that says, "Tap below to reactivate your Sunnyside subscription for $299.00/year." There's a "Reactivate Now" button and you can't even access your account or the app settings! There is no option to sign up for a cheaper plan or even review your progress. This is really predatory and I would never recommend this app to someone trying to cut back. It's advertised as $99/year, yet there's actually no way to sign up for that plan and there is no monthly option. Very scammy.

reviews.title: Accountability without the pressure
reviews.text: Genuinely enjoy using the app- the integration with text messaging makes it really easy to use. I set a goal and have been tracking everyday for over a year now. It helps to be more mindful about habits.

reviews.title: Works
reviews.text: I joined this group in June 2026. It was phenomenal at first!  I thrived and cut my drinking by 90%!

reviews.title: My personal tracking app
reviews.text: I really appreciate how this app has allowed me to track my use of alcohol and the feedback and motivational tips I get everyday.  This is the first time in my life where I have seriously cutback. So thank you

reviews.title: Solid App
reviews.text: Sunnyside has helped me stay accountable with daily tracking and has given me the insight as to how much I was really drinking. Over time, I was able to cut back more than 60% and my body has never felt better!

reviews.title: No support here
reviews.text: Sure would like to try this app. Too bad it takes me through half the setup before informing me it doesn’t support the country where I am! People travel. People move. It can be overwhelming. I really could use this support!

reviews.title: It helps
reviews.text:
I have been tracking my alcohol consumption for two years. I have decreased my drinking and increased my dry days with this app. I dont always hit my target but I try to keep my target low but within my "do-able range. I find Naltrexone helps.
I love that Sunnyside is there EVERY DAY with me. I love the notifications and the tracking numbers. I occasionally check out other people's journey and enjoy that.  Support is always available.

reviews.title: Community support and reminders
reviews.text:
I appreciate several things about the Sunnyside app. It is geared toward helping folks stay in control. There is no pressure to abstain completely. But, there are reminders and support offered if you appear to be going beyond the limits you yourself have set. It is also flexible in that you may change targets you’ve set if you feel the day warrants it.
Some of the automated responses are a bit robotic. But, overall and for the price, this is a great app.

reviews.title: I’m a fan 🏆
reviews.text: Easy accountability and tracking. I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: The reminders are very helpful, and I appreciate getting feedback that’s not judgmental. The app makes it easier to track my drinking habits and figure out how to improve.

reviews.title: Life changer!
reviews.text: I’m a boss, mostly because I don’t like being bossed around. I also don’t need to stop drinking entirely. I just needed to curtail my consumption and this app has made that absolutely, pleasantly possible. It’s perfect for me.

reviews.title: A good companion
reviews.text: Very helpful app to track my drinking and try to manage it better. Still struggling but I’m improving and am aware of my drinking habits which is important.

reviews.title: Started pushing medication instead if mindfulness
reviews.text: Enjoyed the app for the first few months, useful to track basic drinking habits, but got very irritated when Sunnyside sent text messages pushing the idea of medication to control drinking, vs mindfulness and healthy habits.  As a paying subscriber I don’t want to be pushed ads, especially for medications

reviews.title: Mindfulness made easy
reviews.text: I enjoy being able to set my own goals and change my mind if I want to. Simple. And I really enjoy being able to tailor it to events in my life that fit my week’s goal in terms of drinking mindfully.

reviews.title: This app changed my life
reviews.text: It sounds dramatic but it’s the truth. I downloaded this app after unexpectedly losing my 32 year old sister to alcoholism, which made me reevaluating my relationship with alcohol. I now drink 68% (!!!!) less on average each week than when I first started using Sunnyside. It took me a year to achieve this, but I feel healthiest and most in control I’ve ever been. When I started this app, drinking 7 glasses of alcohol a week (or less) was laughable. Now, I’m not even hitting the full 7 glasses some weeks. I’m so proud of myself….and so grateful to the creators of this app. I couldn’t have achieved this goal without Sunnyside! My subscription just renewed and it was the easiest $99 I’ve ever spent.

reviews.title: Best One
reviews.text: I have tried multiple apps and programs over the years. This one truly is the best.

reviews.title: Great tool
reviews.text: I’ve used Sunnyside for a few years once I realized that heavy drinking for women is only eight drinks a week or more. It’s definitely helped me be more mindful!

reviews.title: I love it!
reviews.text: I love the positive and gentle approach and tone of the accountability the app provides. I love the daily text reminders for tracking and the trends and milestones identified and shared.

reviews.title: Extremely useful application and tool with live help and auto reminders
reviews.text: Sunnyside does an  awesome job of gently reminding about daily goals and providing the tools to address less drinking. One can go as deep as they want to into this process using Sunnyside and it’s extremely valuable.

reviews.title: Subscription only
reviews.text: This is subscription only. I wish I had read more into it. This app makes it impossible to delete your account.

reviews.title: Over Charged
reviews.text: I cancelled my subscription for medication. When I was then charged for a refill the next month, I emailed support. They couldn’t refund the improper charge because the refill was in process? I guess I’m just out $300??

reviews.title: Feeling grateful and proud
reviews.text: I don’t feel I have a drinking problem, but I want to cut back for health reasons.  It’s been very helpful in keeping track of what my drinking plan for the week is. It has a simple weekly questionnaire. How many drinks per day and how many dry days. I’m super proud of myself. I’ve cut my drinking in half, (around 7 per week).  Helping to keep me accountable to myself.

reviews.title: Self discovery
reviews.text: I have been a daily drinker for 35 years with only a few brief experiments with abstinence and/or moderation. I’m also a runner and numbers geek. Sunnyside has worked for me in the same way that workout tracking, miles run, and daily step counts have provided motivation. It’s a fantastic tool if you’re into goal setting and tracking performance. The coaches are caring, supportive, and quick to respond.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: All this app does is track your drinks. Get a pen and paper and save the $100.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Very good, except the button to add drinks often doesn’t properly and I have to press it repeatedly again and again but it doesn’t work properly. Seems to be a bug

reviews.title: Judgement Free
reviews.text: This app really helped me understand my drinking and cut way back. I feel I have regained control over my life. There is no pressure to quit drinking altogether unless that’s what you want. The focus is daily accountability and the community and coaches help a lot!

reviews.title: Mindful drinking
reviews.text: I’ve cut down almost 50% but can still enjoy a drink or two. It works.

reviews.title: It really helps
reviews.text: Sunnyside really helps its members focus and be mindful of how much alcohol you consume on a daily basis. There is no pressure or guilt trips just support. The community is super supportive, caring, and we are all going through the journey together. The coaches are always there to help through the day. And there are many great resources to help educate and to make decisions easier.

reviews.title: Trackable & Accountable
reviews.text: Update - Their method is perfect for me - someone who wanted (needed) to cut back for physical and mental health reasons. It’s trackable (you can see your entire journey) and holds you accountable by putting you in charge. The text message is perfect because it isn’t one more app I have to check - I’m asked every day and it’s easy to respond. It’s low pressure, so any “mistakes” aren’t full of judgement, they always respond with encouragement. Been using over 3 years now and will keep with it!

reviews.title: Changed a 30 year habit
reviews.text: After being a daily drinker for at least 25 years, and probably close to 30, Sunnyside was a critical piece of my transformation. I leaned in hard and tracked daily. I listened to the podcast, I contributed to and learned from the community. I’ve lost over 50 pounds, my job is better, my family is better, and I’m actively living the life I dream of. Alcohol was the keystone habit that had to change for all of the other goodness to follow and Sunnyside (with its community) was absolutely an essential component.

reviews.title: Grateful
reviews.text: So grateful for Sunnyside. I love the community that I check in with everyday. I enjoy the daily reflection question which helps me to stay focused and motivated, and of course, the daily check in, which holds me accountable.

reviews.title: Cutting back
reviews.text: This is a great way to reduce your drinking without the absolutism of having to stop entirely.  I just celebrated having dropped 100 drinks from my schedule over the past 18 months!

reviews.title: Such a scam!
reviews.text: Stay away from this app, if you don’t want to be bc gather a $100 for a free trial. I signed up for the 2-week free trial, but was charged for a whole year immediately. Contacting the support was useless, they just sent generic replies refusing to issue a refund. The App Store support was also not helpful, so if you have a $100 to spare for a useless app, you should download it. Otherwise, stay away from these scammers.

reviews.title: Works!
reviews.text: If and when you’re ready, a little reminder, a nudge in the right direction can be all that’s needed.
